clause: We share anonymized usage data with analytics partners.

strict.reason: The clause could potentially expose the reader to privacy risks or data sharing beyond their control, even if the data is anonymized.

generous.reason: The clause merely states that anonymized usage data will be shared with analytics partners, which does not directly cost the reader money, rights, time, options, or personal data.

adjudicator.plain: The clause states that anonymized usage data will be shared with analytics partners.
adjudicator.action: Ask the company to provide a detailed privacy notice explaining which analytics partners will receive the data and how it will be used, and request an option to opt out of such sharing.
adjudicator.quote: We share anonymized usage data with analytics partners.
